company.title: Company
company.taxAccountingDescription: The accounting framework determines the chart installed; the accounts used by automatic postings remain editable in the chart of accounts.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Shown in the sidebar and on printed documents.

numbering.title: Numbering
numbering.description: Legal sequences per document type and fiscal year.
numbering.info: Numbers are assigned by the server at validation time, within the document's transaction: two devices cannot get the same one. Offline, a provisional number {{code}} is shown until synchronization.
numbering.emptyDescription: Sequences are created when the first document of each type is issued.

registers.title: Cash registers
registers.description: Points of sale and session history.
registers.emptyRegistersDescription: A cash register is required to open a sales session.
registers.emptySessionsDescription: Sessions appear as soon as a cash register is first opened.

dialog.warehouseHint: Determines where the sold stock comes from.

users.title: Users
users.description: Accounts attached to this company and the roles assigned to them.
users.emptyDescription: Create accounts for your salespeople, storekeepers and accountants.

dialog.description: Assigned roles only apply to the current company.
dialog.keepPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the current one.
dialog.allowOffline: Allow offline sign-in on a synchronized desktop device

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: Hiding things in the interface is a convenience; authorization is checked on every server call.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Enable only what you use: the menu stays simple. Disabling a module never deletes your data.
modules.step1Description: For any kind of business. You can fine-tune afterwards.
modules.step2Description: Products, customers, payments and settings are always available.
modules.confirmDescription: Enabled modules: {{modules}}. The others will be hidden, without any data loss.
